type ServiceTestSuite struct {

func (s *ServiceTestSuite) SetUpSuite(c *check.C) {
	utils.InitLoggerForTests(testing.Verbose())
}

func (s *ServiceTestSuite) TestDebugModeEnv(c *check.C) {
	c.Assert(isDebugMode(), check.Equals, false)
	os.Setenv(teleport.DebugEnvVar, "no")
	c.Assert(isDebugMode(), check.Equals, false)
	os.Setenv(teleport.DebugEnvVar, "0")
	c.Assert(isDebugMode(), check.Equals, false)
	os.Setenv(teleport.DebugEnvVar, "1")
	c.Assert(isDebugMode(), check.Equals, true)
	os.Setenv(teleport.DebugEnvVar, "true")
	c.Assert(isDebugMode(), check.Equals, true)
}

func (s *ServiceTestSuite) TestSelfSignedHTTPS(c *check.C) {
	fileExists := func(fp string) bool {
		_, err := os.Stat(fp)
		if err != nil && os.IsNotExist(err) {
			return false
		}
		return true
	}
	cfg := &Config{
		DataDir:  c.MkDir(),
		Hostname: "example.com",
		Log:      utils.WrapLogger(logrus.New().WithField("test", c.TestName())),
	}
	err := initSelfSignedHTTPSCert(cfg)
	c.Assert(err, check.IsNil)
	c.Assert(cfg.Proxy.KeyPairs, check.HasLen, 1)
	c.Assert(fileExists(cfg.Proxy.KeyPairs[0].Certificate), check.Equals, true)
	c.Assert(fileExists(cfg.Proxy.KeyPairs[0].PrivateKey), check.Equals, true)
}

item.text:
Resolved the tsh test environment failures. `Run` and its command handlers now return errors, runtime options can be applied after parsing, and a mock SSO login function is passed through to the client. Auth and Proxy services now propagate their OS assigned listener addresses, including ports chosen for `:0`.

I added regression coverage for returned CLI errors and dynamic proxy addresses. The client, service, and tsh package tests pass with module network access disabled; `git diff --check` passes.

Three subagents handled the client, service, and `tsh.go` edits. I integrated the database handler changes and tests, then verified the final patch.
